verdicts.summary: No fabricated or mis-dated event found: 15 events checked on 6 pages plus the infobox area, all confirmed. Returned to the author for missing and inconsistent land events. Blocking: (1) the 1873/1877 corrections drop Fernando Po, Annobon and Ifni with no event; (2) the 1898 dissolve gives the Pacific islands to the US against the dossier's own note; (3) the Inca conquest after 1535 has no mirror for inca-empire's 1537, 1567-1571 and 1572 events. Also to fix: Michoacan dated 1530 by its dossier, Colonia and southern Brazil events, Annobon, Philippine certainty. One fix applied by the reviewer (Muisca slug).
